blog_title: T-Shirt Shrinkage Test for Bulk Orders — How 6% Shrinkage Rejected a ₹45K 200 GSM Order
caption:
₹40k order rejected — client said 200 GSM felt cheap. 😬

Here's the truth: GSM is just weight. We learned the hard way that yarn type (combed vs. carded), biowash treatment, and knit tightness matter WAY more.

Same 200 GSM can feel premium or flimsy depending on these 3 factors.

Save this post before your next bulk order.
